ItemID: NA; Title: Down To My Last Bad Habit; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am more interested in orchestral music and expressive vocal performances right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: This Is Not A Test; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do not see a clear connection to the music I have been enjoying lately.
ItemID: NA; Title: Legend: The Best of Willie Nelson; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have enjoyed some country music, but I am not seeking a country collection this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: A Pentatonix Christmas; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I enjoy Christmas music occasionally, but I am not in a holiday listening mood.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Impossible Dream; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: The theatrical song association appeals to my interest in Stages and expressive vocal music.
ItemID: NA; Title: His Christmas Album; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Seasonal music is not what I want to hear right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Sanremo Grande Amore; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: This looks promising for the romantic vocal sound I enjoyed on Amor & Pasion.
ItemID: NA; Title: A Musical Affair; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: I enjoyed A Musical Affair: Live in Japan, so I would choose this closely related album.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Ultimate Collection; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Without an artist or track listing, I cannot tell whether this matches my taste.
